EA SPORTS FC 27 releases Sept 25, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://ninten.do/6006a6ATC

Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC 27! 

Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more accurate football gameplay.
